topic: Admission Team Structure and Lead Visibility
summary: Describes how to establish hierarchical admission team structures to manage lead visibility. It clarifies that senior team leads can view their sub-teams' data, but sub-teams cannot see each other's data, nor can team leads see other team leads' data unless a common member exists.
steps: Navigate to Admission Setup > Admission Team.
If a team structure is not needed (e.g., single senior person with multiple counselors), delete any existing team structure and save.
Add 'Members' to the team (e.g., Himanshi, Shresti, Deepak, Anaita).
Repeat for other teams (e.g., 'External Team' with Gaurav Sachan as lead and Mani, Pallavi, Sukhpeeth as members).
business_rules: Team leads can view the lead data of their direct team members.
Team members cannot view the lead data of other team members (even within the same team).
Team leads cannot view the lead data of other teams' leads or members, unless a specific member is common to both teams.
If a member is common to multiple teams, all respective team leads can view that common member's data.
important_notes: Team structures are typically used in specific scenarios, such as distinct outreach and inside admission teams.
If there's a flat structure (one senior, multiple counselors), a team structure is generally not required.
